source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.official_english: China's Private Education Sector Undergoes a Major Reshuffle
topics.why_hot: Parents and educators are closely watching changes in private schools, which affect enrollment, tuition and teaching quality.
topics.share_angle: Break down what the 'reshuffle' means for private-school students, teachers and families, and compare it with public education trends in China.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国集成电路海外大爆发
topics.official_english: China's Integrated Circuit Industry Sees Rapid Growth in Overseas Markets
topics.why_hot: Semiconductors are strategically important, and reports of expanding overseas sales draw attention to China's tech competitiveness.
topics.share_angle: Explain the drivers behind the export growth, the global chip supply chain, and the challenges ahead such as export controls and competition.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国汽车何以全球圈粉
topics.official_english: Why Chinese Cars Are Winning Fans Globally
topics.why_hot: Chinese automakers are increasingly visible on the world stage, prompting curiosity about their quality, design and technology.
topics.share_angle: Highlight factors behind the global appeal, such as EVs, smart features and pricing, and explain what it means for the global auto market.

topics.chinese_topic: 多地立法禁止学生带手机入校
topics.official_english: More Regions Enact Rules Banning Students From Bringing Phones to School
topics.why_hot: The regulation directly affects millions of students and parents, and fuels debate over technology, study habits and child development.
topics.share_angle: Summarize the new rules, present different views from schools and parents, and discuss the balance between digital access and classroom discipline.

topics.official_english: China Women's Volleyball Team Advances to Final
topics.why_hot: The national team's success sparks patriotic excitement and celebration among sports fans.
topics.share_angle: Recap the team's journey to the final, highlight key players and moments, and preview the championship match.

topics.chinese_topic: 用这种微信头像或被封号
topics.official_english: WeChat Warns Certain Profile Pictures May Lead to Account Bans
topics.why_hot: WeChat is one of China's most essential apps, so account rules attract wide attention and sometimes anxiety.
topics.share_angle: Clarify what kinds of avatars are problematic, remind readers to follow official guidelines, and discuss platform moderation and user privacy.

topics.chinese_topic: 常冰玉10-7击败世界第一赵心童夺冠
topics.official_english: Chang Bingyu Defeats World No. 1 Zhao Xintong to Claim Title
topics.why_hot: An upset victory in snooker draws attention from sports fans, especially the young winner beating a top-ranked player.
topics.share_angle: Tell the story of the match, highlight Chang's breakthrough, and explain the significance in the snooker world.

topics.official_english: Six Foods That May Be More Anti-Inflammatory When Eaten Raw
topics.why_hot: Health-conscious readers are always looking for easy diet tips, especially around inflammation and wellness.
topics.share_angle: List the six foods with a clear caveat about safety and nutrition, and encourage readers to consult professionals if they have health conditions.
